assets.name: Deep Star Maps 2020 — celestial (ICRF/J2000) equirectangular star map, 8k, tone-mapped

projection.verifiedWith: 15 bright stars (Sirius, Canopus, Arcturus, Vega, Capella, Rigel, Procyon, Achernar, Betelgeuse, Altair, Aldebaran, Antares, Spica, Fomalhaut, Deneb) all land on saturated pixels; the mirrored hypothesis scores ~0

encoding.toneMap: v' = 1 - exp(-2.5*v), then sRGB transfer; 8-bit JPEG q88 4:4:4
encoding.note: Relative star brightness is NOT photometric after tone mapping; bright stars saturate as in the source.
